items.text: Patrick Mahomes is day-to-day with right elbow injury sustained Sunday vs Jets; he returned to the game. Andy Reid: more positive than negative, rehab for soreness. MRI showed no major injury per Rapoport.
items.why: Hit on throwing elbow; returned and competed; MRI clean of major structural damage; Reid positive Monday.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 10 vs ATL but monitor practice participation and any docks on volume/mobility.
items.opportunity: If limited, slight bump to backup QB or increased run game; Rice/Worthy roles steady if Mahomes plays.

items.text: Josh Jacobs fractured finger (right ring) Sunday, exited early and did not return. Initially hoped to play through; now reports of surgery expected, out maximum of 3 weeks.
items.why: Finger caught in facemask on stiff-arm; fractured; LaFleur initially optimistic on playing through, then surgery decision.
items.implication: Misses multiple weeks; GB RB committee likely with elevated snaps for backups.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup opportunity expansion for Marshawn Lloyd and others in Packers backfield.

items.text: ETR comprehensive Sunday injury watch: Nacua knee, Mahomes elbow (returned)+Worthy hamstring, Stevenson knee, Jacobs hand, Waddle concussion, McConkey back+Herbert undisclosed, McCarthy hip (returned), Willis groin (returned), Ferguson knee, Goodson knee; added Lock oblique.
items.why: Post-Sunday compilation of key fantasy injuries for monitoring into Week 10.
items.implication: Multiple high-priority statuses to track via practice reports midweek.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries across several teams if any ruled OUT/INACTIVE.

items.text: Puka Nacua suffered a knee injury on the Rams' final offensive snap Sunday and will undergo MRI Monday; team does not believe it is a torn ACL but imaging will confirm extent.
items.why: Hard hit on late jet sweep/run; walked off with brace/limp; Schefter/Garafolo report no ACL belief pending MRI.
items.implication: High-end WR1 availability for Week 10 in doubt; monitor Monday results closely.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, elevated targets/routes for Davante Adams and Kyren Williams in LAR offense.

items.text: Sam Darnold ruled out this week (quad); Drew Lock oblique strain tests 'good' and expected to start vs Raiders. ETR added Lock to injury notes.
items.why: Macdonald: Darnold out, Lock oblique minor/good tests, believes he can start.
items.implication: SEA QB is Lock for Week 10; impacts passing game projections and JSN etc.
items.opportunity: Stable for SEA pass-catchers if Lock plays fully; no major downgrade expected.

items.text: Notable RB opportunity splits Sunday: Hall return 19 opp vs Allen 10 (Allen outsnapped 37-27); DEN Coleman 58 snaps/dominant last 2 wks vs Dobbins 11; SEA Charbonnet 37-24 snaps/13-9 routes over Jadarian Price; LV Jeanty 32 snaps/24-6 routes vs Washington (carries even 6-6 trailing).
items.why: Post-game snap/route/opportunity data from Levitan showing clear lead-back leans or shared work.
items.implication: Hall lead but Allen steals snaps; Coleman clear lead DEN; Charbonnet preferred SEA; Jeanty primary but committee carries possible.
items.opportunity: Prefer Hall/Coleman/Jeanty/Charbonnet in rankings; Price/Dobbins handcuff or committee value only.

items.text: Justin Herbert will undergo testing on middle finger of left (non-throwing) hand; Jim Harbaugh said it could be a fracture.
items.why: Undisclosed/finger issue noted in ETR watch; Harbaugh comments on possible fracture post-game.
items.implication: Non-throwing hand may allow play but grip/ball security risk; Chargers offense already struggling.
items.opportunity: If out/limited, Ladd McConkey and Omarion Hampton still primary but QB downgrade impacts all.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) ruled out after hit in Broncos win; entered protocol. Listed on ETR Sunday injury watch.
items.why: Violent hit while extending for catch; mandatory protocol; DEN has upcoming bye for recovery time.
items.implication: Misses at least next game; clears protocol steps needed for return.
items.opportunity: Target share bump for Courtland Sutton and other DEN WRs.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) injured late in game Sunday, ruled out and did not return; occurred very late per Levitan. ETR watching closely.
items.why: Late third-quarter knee injury; slow to get up, medical tent then locker room; no postgame media.
items.implication: Severity TBD (possible multi-week); NE backfield thin with Henderson also dealing illness issues.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for Corey Kiner or other NE RBs; TreVeyon Henderson if healthy.

items.text: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) left game and is day-to-day per Reid Monday, same as Mahomes and OT Moore.
items.why: Hamstring injury during Chiefs win; Reid grouped with Mahomes as DTD.
items.implication: Monitor practice; if out, more targets to Rashee Rice and depth WRs.
items.opportunity: Rice target concentration rises further if Worthy sits.

items.text: Matthew Berry: Best values at ADP this season are both Packers WRs—Matthew Golden first, Christian Watson second. Extremely impressed by Love/Golden/Watson explosion Sunday.
items.why: Post-game production and season-long ADP value; 'so freaking impressive' on the trio.
items.implication: Strong buy/start signals for Watson (and Golden) ROS and weekly.
items.opportunity: Elevated ranking/start confidence in GB passing game volume.

items.text: Tightest two-player target concentration: NYG Nabers+Likely 54.9%; ARI McBride+Wilson 50.7%; DAL Lamb+Pickens 50.6%; DET Amon-Ra+LaPorta 49.3%; GB Golden+Watson 48.7%. Tee+Chase 47.3%. High ADOT Mitchell volatile.
items.why: Season-long target share data highlighting funnel offenses.
items.implication: High floor/ceiling for listed pairs; volatility for deep-target guys like Mitchell.
items.opportunity: Prioritize these in start/sit and trade value when healthy; two-player games dominate volume.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (back) on ETR Sunday injury watch list alongside Herbert undisclosed; monitor for Week 10 status.
items.why: Back issue noted post-game in comprehensive ETR list.
items.implication: Potential limitation in already volatile LAC offense.
items.opportunity: If out, other LAC WRs/ RBs see bumps but low overall volume.

items.text: Matthew Berry strongly rooting for and loving Tank Dell utilization/return: 'Let's go Tank Dell !!!!!! Easy guy to root for. Love seeing this'.
items.why: Positive post-game reaction to Dell's play/return.
items.implication: Berry sees upside/utilization worth monitoring for fantasy.
items.opportunity: Potential waiver or flex consideration if volume continues.
